observations.body: The speaker says the Lord’s Spirit is on him because the LORD has anointed him to announce good news and release.

observations.body: The mission addresses the poor, brokenhearted, captives, mourners, and ruined lives.

observations.body: Spirit is on me · anointed · good news · liberty

payload.posture: Read Isaiah 61:1–3 as voices before the jordan evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: Isaiah 61 interprets Spirit-anointed mission but does not narrate the baptism itself.
